profile_text.body:
IBM describes IBM OpenPages as a highly scalable, AI-powered, unified GRC platform for data governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance. The company says OpenPages is available on any cloud or on-premises and offers a modular approach to governance, risk, and compliance, letting organizations deploy only the components they need. IBM states that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment. The site describes features including the OpenPages GRC Canvas for modeling processes, risks, and controls, embedded AI for classification and issue creation, and integration with watsonx.ai or other AI models through an API-based architecture. IBM also mentions an OpenPages MCP Server for enabling AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects, and says Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, saving thousands of manual hours.

IBM's AI-related products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, IBM watsonx.governance, and IBM watsonx. IBM OpenPages with Watson is a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance provides AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators; it was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is an enterprise AI platform that includes watsonx.governance for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection, and is model-agnostic.

IBM is a public company founded in 1911, headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, with ticker IBM and CIK 0000051143. It reported revenue of 67535000000 USD for the year ended 2025-12-31 in a 10-K filing. The company has no litigation cases listed and 458 legal exposure entries in New York.
